summary: Documentation and test change with no runtime behaviour change. The only edits under packages/stack/src are JSDoc and comment text in client-v3.ts and wasm-inline.ts (the non-comment diff there is a single blank line). It corrects the stated reason why decrypt/bulkDecrypt do not reconstruct Date values, documents that boundary in the package README and the shipped stash-encryption agent skill, and adds runtime and type tests pinning the existing behaviour. The new docs are consistent with the code read at head: the typed client's decrypt/bulkDecrypt are bare delegations, and only the table-taking model paths build date reconstructors. The skill text ships to customers via the CLI, so its accuracy matters, but nothing I read was inaccurate. No material failure scenario was found. The new tests were not run here (no dependencies installed, no CI results).

behaviour_changes.description: JSDoc on EncryptionClient.decrypt, the new bulkDecrypt JSDoc, the one-arg decryptModel overload and the passthrough comment in createEncryptionClient now say why raw decrypt skips Date reconstruction: static typing, not missing column identity. WasmEncryptionClient.decrypt/bulkDecrypt get matching JSDoc. No executable code changed.

The customer-facing guidance in packages/stack/README.md and skills/stash-encryption/SKILL.md now says raw decrypt/bulkDecrypt return date/timestamp columns as strings. It also stops calling bulkEncrypt an untyped passthrough, and limits the Date reconstruction claim to the table-taking model forms.

Adds runtime tests that pin decrypt/bulkDecrypt to return the stored string through createEncryptionClient, and type tests that pin the raw paths to JsPlaintext with no Date arm (versus Date on the table-taking model path and string on the table-less path). Existing stubs are retyped to the native client parameter type.
Adds a changeset that marks @cipherstash/stack and stash as patch releases, so the next release publishes the updated README and bundled skill text.

evidence.claim: With comment lines filtered out, the only remaining source-diff line is one added blank line. No executable code changed.
The typed client's decrypt and bulkDecrypt are bare delegations to the underlying client, with no reconstruction, which matches the new docs.
WASM decrypt is unchanged and returns WasmPlaintext. datePropertyPaths, which the new JSDoc references, exists at line 647 and is used only for model reconstruction.
README now documents that raw decrypt/bulkDecrypt return no Date, and that bulkEncrypt is typed via { table, column }.
The skill adds a raw-path Date note, narrows the reconstruction claim to the table-taking model forms, and updates the method table.
New runtime tests check that decrypt/bulkDecrypt return the stored ISO string and forward the payload untouched.
New type tests pin the raw decrypt types to JsPlaintext with no Date arm, the model path to Date, and the table-less path to string.
The changeset bumps @cipherstash/stack and stash at patch level and states there is no behaviour change.
The CLI bundles /skills and installs stash-encryption into customer projects.
The typecheck include is __tests__/**/*.test-d.ts, so the new type tests run under test:types. The runtime *.test.ts files are not typechecked.
